releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.1.5

- Generated rebirth tiers, axe upgrades, and axe skins now use unique combinatorial names instead of repeating 'Name #' patterns, with a collision check so no generated name duplicates another.
- Fixed a bug where rebirth tiers 1-5 all rewarded only 1 shard; shard rewards now scale smoothly and distinctly from your very first rebirth.
- Fixed a bug where leaderboard reads and the anonymous sign-in fallback were missing a required Authorization header, causing the leaderboard to fail to load or show stale data.
- Periodic leaderboard score syncing (chickens, rebirths, logs, etc.) now uses the same retry and fallback logic as registration, so it no longer silently fails.
- Added a 'While You Were Away' offline earnings popup on launch.
